terms-of-service.html:
Last Updated: May 2026

Welcome to PressPixel Creations (“Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”). These Terms of Service (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of our website, products, and services available through PressPixel Creations.

By accessing our website or purchasing our services, you agree to these Terms.

  • and all information you provide is accurate and truthful.

3. Payments & Billing

Clients agree to pay all fees associated with purchased services or subscriptions.

Subscription Services

For recurring subscription plans:

Failure to complete payment may result in suspension or termination of services.

4. Refunds

Refunds are governed by our Refund Policy.

Due to the nature of digital services and custom development work, refunds may be limited once work has begun or services have been delivered.

  • maintain lawful use of services,

Delays caused by missing content, approvals, or communication may impact timelines.

Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by the client for the relevant service during the preceding three months.

9. Service Suspension & Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate services if:

Clients may also cancel services according to applicable agreements or subscription terms.

10. Third-Party Services

refund_returns.title: Refund Policy
refund_returns.html:
Last Updated: May 2026

At PressPixel Creations, we strive to provide high-quality digital services and transparent communication throughout every project. This Refund Policy explains how refunds are handled for our subscription-based website and digital marketing services.

1. General Policy

Due to the nature of digital services, custom development work, SEO services, consulting, and subscription-based website management, refunds are limited once work has started or services have been delivered.

By purchasing any service from us, you agree to this Refund Policy.

2. Website Design & Development Services

Initial Payments & Deposits

All upfront payments, setup fees, onboarding fees, and deposits are generally non-refundable once:

  • project planning has started,
  • design work has begun,
  • development has started,
  • or resources have been allocated to the project.

This includes:

  • custom website design,
  • development work,
  • branding implementation,
  • content setup,
  • integrations,
  • technical configurations,
  • and revisions requested by the client.

3. Website-as-a-Service (WaaS) Subscriptions

Our monthly subscription plans may include:

  • hosting,
  • maintenance,
  • updates,
  • SEO,
  • analytics,
  • support,
  • backups,
  • and related digital services.

Subscription Cancellations

Clients may cancel their subscription after the deadline mentioned in the contract providing written notice before the next billing cycle.

After cancellation:

  • future recurring charges will stop,
  • but previously charged subscription fees are non-refundable,
  • and services remain active until the end of the current billing period.

Partial-month refunds are not provided.

4. SEO & Marketing Services

SEO and digital marketing services involve ongoing labor, optimization, technical work, and strategy implementation.

Because search engine rankings and marketing performance cannot be guaranteed, payments for:

  • SEO campaigns,
  • optimization services,
  • local SEO,
  • Google Business Profile optimization,
  • and consulting services

are generally non-refundable once work has begun.

5. Client Delays & Communication

Refunds will not be issued for delays caused by:

  • lack of communication,
  • delayed approvals,
  • missing content or assets,
  • failure to provide required access,
  • or project abandonment by the client.

6. Chargebacks

Clients agree to contact us first before initiating any chargeback or payment dispute.

Initiating fraudulent or abusive chargebacks after services have been delivered may result in:

  • suspension of services,
  • termination of accounts,
  • removal of hosted assets,
  • and submission of supporting evidence to the payment processor.

7. Exceptional Cases

Refund requests may be reviewed on a case-by-case basis at our sole discretion.

Any approved refund:

  • may be partial,
  • may exclude completed work,
  • and may deduct processing fees, labor costs, or third-party expenses already incurred.

8. Contact

For billing or refund-related questions, please contact:

PressPixel Creations
Website: presspixelcreations.com
Email: support@presspixelcreations.com

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:
Last Updated: May 2026

Welcome to PressPixel Creations (“Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit PressPixel Creations or use our services.

By using our website or services, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

Personal Information

When you contact us, fill out forms, purchase services, or communicate with us, we may collect:

  • Full name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Business name
  • Billing information
  • Website details
  • Communication history

Technical Information

We may automatically collect:

  • IP address
  • Browser type
  • Device information
  • Operating system
  • Referral URLs
  • Website usage data
  • Cookies and analytics data

2. How We Use Your Information

We may use your information to:

  • Provide and manage our services
  • Process payments and subscriptions
  • Communicate with clients
  • Improve website functionality
  • Provide customer support
  • Send important service-related updates
  • Analyze website traffic and performance
  • Prevent fraud or abuse
  • Comply with legal obligations
  • Send SMS communications when appropriate consent has been provided
  • Send marketing or promotional communications when the recipient has separately consented to receive them

3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

Our website may use cookies, analytics tools, and similar technologies to improve user experience and analyze website performance.

These technologies may help us:

  • remember user preferences,
  • understand visitor behavior,
  • improve marketing efforts,
  • and optimize website functionality.

You may disable cookies through your browser settings.

4. Third-Party Services

We may use trusted third-party service providers to operate portions of our business, including:

  • payment processors,
  • hosting providers,
  • analytics tools,
  • CRM systems,
  • email platforms,
  • communication providers,
  • and other service providers necessary to operate our services.

These providers may process information only as necessary to perform services on our behalf and subject to applicable contractual and privacy obligations.

SMS opt-in information, mobile phone numbers, and SMS consent records will not be sold, rented, shared, or transferred to third parties or affiliates for promotional or marketing purposes.

We may share SMS-related information with service providers solely when necessary to provide our messaging services, such as telecommunications providers, messaging platforms, and other vendors involved in delivering text messages. These providers may not use SMS opt-in information or consent for their own marketing or promotional purposes.

5. SMS Communications

PressPixel Creations may send SMS messages only to individuals who have provided the applicable consent to receive such messages.

SMS communications may include requested information, customer service communications, scheduling or appointment-related messages, service updates, follow-ups, and, where separately consented to, marketing or promotional messages.

Message frequency may vary. Message and data rates may apply.

You may opt out of SMS communications at any time by replying STOP to any message. You may reply HELP for assistance.

Consent to receive SMS marketing messages is not a condition of purchasing goods or services.

Your mobile information and SMS consent will not be sold or shared with third parties or affiliates for promotional or marketing purposes.

6. Payment Information

Payments are processed through third-party payment providers. We use Stripe for payment processing and may use other secure payment gateways. We do not directly store full payment card information on our servers.

7. Data Security

We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, misuse, disclosure, or loss.

However, no online system can guarantee absolute security.

8. Data Retention

We may retain information:

  • for as long as necessary to provide services,
  • maintain records,
  • comply with legal obligations,
  • resolve disputes,
  • and enforce agreements.

9. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights regarding your personal data, including:

  • access to your data,
  • correction of inaccurate information,
  • deletion requests,
  • restriction of processing,
  • and withdrawal of consent where applicable.

To request data-related actions, contact us using the details below.

10. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of third-party websites.

11. Children’s Privacy

Our services are not directed toward individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updated versions will be posted on this page with a revised “Last Updated” date.

13. Contact Us

If you have questions regarding this Privacy Policy, you may contact us at:

PressPixel Creations
Website: presspixelcreations.com
Email: support@presspixelcreations.com
